Subject: Orchestrator GSI — discovery recap & next steps

Hi Tomasz —

Thanks again for taking the time this morning with the Orchestrator team. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we can lock in a technical deep dive/demo with your engineering lead: 

Recap (30 min discovery):
- Primary driver: accelerate inference for a tenant-managed customer using hybrid (hosted + VPC) deployments.
- Key constraints: strict data residency for EU customers, predictable p99 latency under 300ms for 512-token generations, desire to reduce per-token cost by ~40%.
- Current infra: multi-cloud GKE + some on-prem GPU capacity; favors tooling that can route and fallback without major code changes.

Proposed next step: 60–75 minute technical deep dive + walkthrough where our SE (Marcus) will:
- Demo routing/fallback and cache/batching behavior with a sample prompt set
- Walk through Dedicated vs Private deployment patterns and KMS options
- Surface kernel/quantization trade-offs for your target latencies

Suggested times (all PDT):
- Thu May 21 — 10:00–11:15 (PDT)
- Thu May 21 — 14:00–15:15 (PDT)
- Fri May 22 — 08:30–09:45 (PDT)

Can you confirm which slot works for you and who will join from Orchestrator (engineering + platform/security)? If none work, propose two alternatives and we’ll adjust.

I’ve attached a brief mutual action plan and a demo outline so you can share with your team (attachments: orchestrator-ma-20260520.pdf, redwood-demo-proposal.pptx).

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks — I can join Thu May 21 at 14:00 PDT. A few prep requests so the deep dive is effective: 

1) Can you share a brief sample of the prompt patterns and the token-length distribution you expect for the POC? Even 10–20 example prompts helps us set batching and KV caching expectations.
2) Which model families are you prioritizing (open-weights vs some proprietary stack)? If open, which sizes (7B/13B/70B) so we can prepare quantization profiles to show trade-offs.
3) Any compliance artifacts we should review ahead of time (SOC 2 scope, per-tenant audit requirements)? If you can drop them in the Drive link Camila shared that’d be great.

I attached a short SE prep checklist for the call (redwood-se-prep-checklist.pdf) and will prepare a short demo runbook focused on routing and fallback.

See you Thu — Marcus
